intent: Connect independent specialist tools at their relevant Circle Tour stops without modifying the tools, copying their data engines, or implying a live access verdict.

connections.decision: Choose a shore, island, boat tour or cave visit.
connections.caveat: Compare access and timing before committing a full Bayfield day.

connections.decision: Pick a waterfall with verified public access.
connections.caveat: Not every cascade on the map is legal or practical on a driving day.

connections.decision: Choose Upper Falls, Lower Falls or both.
connections.caveat: Plan walking and parking before leaving the Michigan shore.

connections.decision: Choose a boat, kayak, hike or scenic drive.
connections.caveat: Weather and vessel schedules can change the right choice.

connections.decision: Check whether a freighter visit fits your Sault stop.
connections.caveat: A tracked vessel is not a guaranteed lock passage.

connections.decision: Is there a supported ship-watching opportunity at Canal Park?
connections.caveat: Check the actual vessel picture before waiting beside the bridge.

connections.decision: Follow Great Lakes ships near your next port.
connections.caveat: AIS location is a report, not a verified itinerary.

connections.decision: Check the Sault Ste. Marie crossing.
connections.caveat: This Michigan crossing feed does not cover Pigeon River.

connections.decision: Choose a provincial-park stop that fits your available time.
connections.caveat: Verify access and seasonal trail closures at the park guide.

connections.decision: Choose a Pukaskwa day hike or short visit.
connections.caveat: Highway 627 adds a detour; official access may be restricted.

connections.decision: Choose a Sleeping Giant experience without underestimating distance.
connections.caveat: Trail and bike-to-hike distances are not interchangeable.

connections.decision: Does a Grand Portage ferry fit your actual travel days?
connections.caveat: Schedules and tickets are operator-owned and date-specific.

connections.decision: Explore Isle Royale before adding an island detour.
connections.caveat: The island is not a roadside stop; factor in boat and overnight commitments.

connections.decision: Which Gooseberry waterfall walk fits your time?
connections.caveat: Choose the documented walk, not an assumed accessible route.

connections.decision: Understand the missing Split Rock River bridge before hiking.
connections.caveat: Do not treat the historic loop as a safe river crossing.

connections.decision: What ticket and parking do you actually need at Split Rock?
connections.caveat: Historic interior tickets and state-park entry are different.

connections.decision: Choose a genuine Keweenaw old-growth trail.
connections.caveat: Check seasonal access before heading toward Copper Harbor.

connections.decision: Find a lawful Lake Superior rockhounding opportunity.
connections.caveat: Storms can expose stones, but public collection rules still apply.

connections.decision: Find a historic lighthouse on your route.
connections.caveat: Directory entries do not guarantee tours or public access.

connections.decision: Explore the stories behind Lake Superior shipwrecks.
connections.caveat: Historical records are not permission to dive or enter a site.

connections.decision: Check measured Lake Superior conditions.
connections.caveat: Offshore buoys do not certify local beaches, boats or kayak launches as safe.

connections.decision: Compare current Upper Peninsula fall-color context.
connections.caveat: Seasonal timing is not confirmation that a specific trail is open.

roadChecks.label: Wisconsin 511
roadChecks.note: Open official Wisconsin road and construction reports. No live status is inferred here.

roadChecks.label: Michigan Mi Drive
roadChecks.note: Check Michigan incidents and MDOT route closures. Not every local road is covered.

roadChecks.label: Ontario 511
roadChecks.note: Check Highway 17 closures, roadwork and conditions directly with Ontario.

roadChecks.label: Minnesota 511
roadChecks.note: Check the Minnesota North Shore highway before departing; non-state roads may be omitted.

futureToolContract.defaultBehavior: Discovery yields candidates only. Approval plus a valid first-party canonical and stop mapping publishes the tool at the next site build. No specialist files are modified.
